data.narrative:
Second Front Systems is a Series B-stage defense and security frontier-tech company that has raised $90M+ to date. Valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 10 peers: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms in the same sector and stage.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the $90M total raised as a proxy baseline, applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical for Series B advancement, yielding $171M. Peer-median analysis examines 7 same-sector, same-stage comparables—Dream Security ($3.0B), Harmattan AI ($1.4B), Code Metal ($1.2B), Castelion ($1.0B), and Defense Unicorns ($1.0B), among others—establishing a median valuation of $1.0B with a range of $300M to $3.0B. The dispersion reflects variance in commercial traction and defensibility within the cohort.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $145M (low), $586M (median), and $1.1B (high). The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around Second Front's relative competitive positioning within a sector displaying significant valuation variance at this stage. Key drivers of upside or downside include revenue trajectory relative to peers, customer diversification within defense and security end-markets, and technical differentiation. The median estimate of $586M sits materially above stage-progression signals but below peer medians, suggesting moderate valuation relative to the comp set.
